agency.description: The issuing agency named in the letterhead, e.g. 'Social Security Administration'

letter_title.description: The letter's title under the agency name, e.g. 'Benefit Verification Letter'

letter_date.description: The date after 'Date:' at the top right, as printed

bnc_number.description: The reference printed after 'BNC#:' at the top right, exactly as printed

recipient.description: The person the letter is addressed to, from the mailing block

name.description: The recipient's name as printed in the address block

mailing_address.description: The recipient's full mailing address as one line, joining the address lines with commas

current_benefits.description: The 'Information About Current Social Security Benefits' section

period_start.description: The first month this section's amounts apply from, as printed, e.g. 'December 2025' or 'July 2025'

period_end.description: The last month this section's amounts apply to, as printed, e.g. 'November 2025'; null when the section gives only a start month

gross_monthly_benefit.description: The full monthly Social Security benefit before any deductions, in dollars, as a number without $ or commas

medical_insurance_premium_deduction.description: The amount deducted each month for medical insurance (Medicare) premiums, in dollars, as a number without $ or commas

net_monthly_payment.description: The regular monthly Social Security payment after deductions, rounded down to the whole dollar, in dollars, as a number without $ or commas

past_benefits.description: The 'Information About Past Social Security Benefits' section

period_start.description: The first month this section's amounts apply from, as printed, e.g. 'December 2025' or 'July 2025'

period_end.description: The last month this section's amounts apply to, as printed, e.g. 'November 2025'; null when the section gives only a start month

gross_monthly_benefit.description: The full monthly Social Security benefit before any deductions, in dollars, as a number without $ or commas

medical_insurance_premium_deduction.description: The amount deducted each month for medical insurance (Medicare) premiums, in dollars, as a number without $ or commas

net_monthly_payment.description: The regular monthly Social Security payment after deductions, rounded down to the whole dollar, in dollars, as a number without $ or commas

payment_day.description: When benefits are paid each month, e.g. 'the fourth Wednesday of each month'

disability_onset_date.description: The date SSA found the person became disabled under its rules, as printed; null if the letter does not say

benefit_type.description: The type of benefit the person is entitled to, from 'Type of Social Security Benefit Information', e.g. 'monthly disability benefits'

hospital_insurance_start.description: The month Medicare hospital insurance (Part A) entitlement begins, as printed, e.g. 'August 2025'

medical_insurance_start.description: The month Medicare medical insurance (Part B) entitlement begins, as printed

medicare_number.description: The Medicare number (MBI) exactly as printed

date_of_birth.description: The date of birth shown on SSA's records, as printed

local_office.description: The local Social Security office named under 'If You Have Questions'

phone.description: The local office phone number, as printed

address.description: The local office's name and address as one line, joining lines with commas
